# Seller Payout Redesign: Holds, Settlement, Clawbacks, Disputes

**Problem:** Sellers are not paid on time.  
**Root cause pattern (industry-standard):** risk controls and dispute handling collapse into **unbounded account freezes**, while settlement clocks, hold clocks, and clawback clocks are **stacked and opaque**. Faster payouts raise platform risk unless liability, reserves, and recovery are explicit.[[1]](https://www.rapyd.net/blog/8-marketplace-chargeback-reasons-how-to-reduce/)

This redesign separates **when money is earned**, **when money is protected**, **when money moves**, and **when money is contested** — so good sellers get predictable cash flow without removing platform protection.
